is_anopheles.evidence: Anopheles gambiae s.l. larvae were collected from breeding sites in villages around Butemba Health Centre III, Uganda (Page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped kdr-L1014S (Vgsc L995S), kdr-L1014F (Vgsc L995F), and Ace-1 G119S (Ace-1 G280S) using TaqMan qPCR assays (Page 2, Table 1).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 (Page 4) reports exact genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) for kdr-L1014S in 732 An. gambiae s.s. and 73 An. arabiensis mosquitoes. Page 4 also notes all specimens were homozygous susceptible at the ace-1 locus.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected from breeding sites in villages in Butemba, Kyankwanzi District, mid-western Uganda (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical field and laboratory experimental study.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes and parasite samples were collected between August 2013 and June 2014 (Page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine primary field study and experimental research in Butemba, Uganda.

supplement.evidence: All required genotype counts, species identification, and bioassay results are fully reported in the main text and Table 1.

assessment.summary: This study investigated the effects of sub-lethal deltamethrin exposure on Plasmodium falciparum sporogonic development in wild pyrethroid-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.s. from Butemba, Kyankwanzi District, Uganda. Mosquitoes were collected as larvae between August 2013 and June 2014. Target resistance markers Vgsc L995S, Vgsc L995F, and Ace-1 G280S were genotyped, with full genotype counts provided for 732 An. gambiae s.s. and 73 An. arabiensis in Table 1. Standard WHO susceptibility tests for deltamethrin were also reported.
